result.title: Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth
result.summary: Predictive coding networks perform credit assignment through an energy minimization process. Despite their ability to train models with arbitrary network topologies, they have mostly been used to train feedforward architectures to match the performance of backpropagation. However, they fail to do so when the models become too deep, because error signals become unstable or vanish as they travel through many layers. We address this limitation with circular networks, which get their depth directly from the energy minimization, rather than from stacking layers. Formally, we prove that convergence to an equilibrium of the energy functional of a circular predictive coding network approximates the fixed-point iteration process of a deep equilibrium model, showing that circularity alone suffices to unlock effective depth. Empirically, we show that circular models (i) outperform other predictive coding models of the same size on image classification tasks, matching the accuracy of state-of-the-art predictive coding ResNets and VGG networks despite having substantially fewer parameters; (ii) solve constraint satisfaction problems that require many steps of iterative reasoning, a task not feasible with feedforward models at all, reaching 99.3% test accuracy on Sudoku-hard via nested energy minimization loops; and (iii) scale to autoregressive language modeling by training a circular transformer on TinyStories and WikiText-103, before out of reach for predictive coding models. These results have direct implications for physical neural networks, where computational depth can be traded for recursion on a fixed-size circuit.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 predictive coding 在深层网络中误差信号不稳定或消失的问题，提出 circular 网络，让深度来自能量最小化而非堆叠层，并证明其收敛到平衡点近似 deep equilibrium 模型的不动点迭代；在图像分类、Sudoku 约束满足和自回归语言建模上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用循环迭代换取有效深度、以能量最小化更新内部状态的机制，与 LVR 关注的 loop 式状态更新、动态计算和迭代推理步数直接相关，可供核查循环平衡点是否可作为 latent 推理状态的生成与训练载体；但未涉及视觉语言推理或视觉证据筛选。
